about: Ready-made prompt packs (our own wording). The owner picks one in the Studio (tab 'Prompt paketleri') or on Telegram ('paketler'); the write step turns it into a post with the prompts theme. Mix (owner, 2026-09-26): ~60% social media + AI agent and money, the rest finance, trading, health, learning, spirituality, niche ideas. Headlines may promise the result boldly (money figures OK), no disclaimer lines (owner, 2026-09-26). photo_query = search words for the cover photo when there is no person. A pack counts as used once content/<date>_<id>.json exists.

packs.title_tr: Yüzsüz (faceless) sayfa + AI agent ile aylık gelir hedefi
packs.title: prompts to run a faceless page with an AI agent
packs.headline: A faceless page + one AI agent can make you $3,000 a month. 7 prompts to build it:

prompts.name: The Niche Picker
prompts.sub: Find a niche that pays before you post once
prompts.prompt: Act as a strategist who has grown faceless pages. Give me 5 faceless page niches for [PLATFORM] that could realistically reach [$3,000] a month. For each: the audience, 3 ways it makes money, how crowded it is, and **ONE PROOF** that people already pay in that niche.

prompts.name: The Content Engine
prompts.sub: 30 days of posts from one brainstorm
prompts.prompt: Be my content director for a faceless [NICHE] page. Build a 30-day plan as a table: 3 content pillars, the format for each day (carousel, Reel, story), a hook for every post, and which posts should send people to my [PRODUCT OR LINK].

prompts.name: The Agent Blueprint
prompts.sub: What an AI agent can do for you every day
prompts.prompt: Act as an automation architect. Design an AI agent workflow for my [NICHE] page using [n8n / Make / Zapier]: it finds trending topics, drafts captions in my voice, builds a posting schedule and sends me everything to **APPROVE**. List each step, the tool for it, and what I still do by hand.

prompts.name: The Hook Factory
prompts.sub: Stop the scroll in the first line
prompts.prompt: Write 20 scroll-stopping hooks about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Use 5 styles: a bold claim, a question, a number, a mistake, a before/after. Keep each under 12 words, nothing I can't back up, and mark the **3 TO TEST FIRST** with the reason.

prompts.name: The Money Map
prompts.sub: Every income stream, in the right order
prompts.prompt: Act as a creator monetization coach. My faceless page has [FOLLOWERS] followers in [NICHE]. Map every realistic income stream (affiliates, sponsors, a digital product, UGC): what each needs, what it typically pays, and the **ORDER** to launch them to reach [$3,000] a month.

prompts.name: The Sponsor Pitch
prompts.prompt: Write a short sponsorship pitch to [BRAND] from my [NICHE] page with [FOLLOWERS] followers and [ENGAGEMENT RATE]% engagement. Include a one-line opener, why my audience fits their product, 3 package options with prices, and a polite follow-up for 5 days later.

prompts.name: The Growth Auditor
prompts.sub: Find out why a post flopped
prompts.prompt: Act as a growth analyst. Here are my last 10 posts with reach, saves and shares: [PASTE STATS]. Tell me what the top 3 have in common, what the weakest 3 did wrong, 3 experiments for next week, and a **REALISTIC** follower range for the next 30 days.

packs.title_tr: Büyük takipçi olmadan markalara UGC video satmak
packs.title: prompts to land your first paid UGC deal
packs.headline: Brands will pay you $150-$500 per video, even with zero followers. 7 prompts to land your first UGC deal:

prompts.name: The Portfolio Builder
prompts.sub: 3 sample videos before anyone pays you
prompts.prompt: Act as a UGC coach. I have no clients yet. Plan 3 sample UGC videos I can film at home with products I already own in [CATEGORY]: the product, the angle, a 30-second script, and the shot list. Make each one show a different **SKILL** brands pay for.

prompts.name: The Brand Finder
prompts.sub: Who is actually buying UGC right now
prompts.prompt: Help me find brands that buy UGC in [CATEGORY]. Give me 10 types of brands to target, the signs a brand already pays for UGC (ads, creator posts, hiring pages), where to find their marketing contact, and which **5** to pitch first.

prompts.name: The Script Writer
prompts.sub: Ads that sound like a real person
prompts.prompt: Write 3 UGC ad scripts for [PRODUCT] aimed at [AUDIENCE], 20-35 seconds each: a problem-solution, an unboxing, and a 'things I wish I knew' style. Add the first-3-second hook, what to show on screen, and the **CALL TO ACTION** for each.

prompts.name: The Pitch DM
prompts.prompt: Write a short cold email and a DM to [BRAND] offering UGC videos for [PRODUCT]. I'm new but have 3 samples: [LINK]. Keep it under 90 words, lead with an idea for their product, not with me, and end with **ONE CLEAR** question.

prompts.name: The Rate Card
prompts.sub: Price it so you don't work for free
prompts.prompt: Act as a UGC business mentor. Build my rate card as a beginner in [COUNTRY]: price per video, a 3-video bundle, raw footage, usage rights for [30/90] days and whitelisting. Explain each line in one sentence so I can defend it on a call.

prompts.name: The Hook Variations
prompts.prompt: I filmed a UGC video for [PRODUCT]. Here is the script: [PASTE SCRIPT]. Write 5 alternative opening hooks I can record in 10 minutes so the brand can test them as separate ads, and tell me which hook fits a **COLD AUDIENCE** best.

prompts.name: The Repeat Client
prompts.sub: Turn one deal into a monthly retainer
prompts.prompt: I delivered my first UGC videos to [BRAND]. Write the delivery message, a short results check-in for 2 weeks later, and a proposal for a monthly package of [NUMBER] videos, with 3 fresh content ideas that make saying **YES** easy.

packs.title_tr: ChatGPT'yi LinkedIn ghostwriter'ına çevirip gelen müşteri toplamak
packs.title: prompts to turn AI into your LinkedIn ghostwriter
packs.headline: Turn ChatGPT into your LinkedIn ghostwriter and let $5,000 clients come to you. 7 prompts:

prompts.name: The Voice Cloner
prompts.sub: Posts that sound like you, not a robot
prompts.prompt: Here are 3 posts or messages I wrote: [PASTE TEXT]. Study my voice: sentence length, words I use, humor, how I open and close. Write a short style guide from it, then rewrite this draft in **MY VOICE**: [PASTE DRAFT].

prompts.name: The Positioning Line
prompts.prompt: Act as a personal brand strategist. I'm a [JOB] who helps [AUDIENCE] with [PROBLEM]. Write 5 headline options for my LinkedIn profile, a 3-line About intro, and the **3 TOPICS** I should post about so the right clients remember me.

prompts.name: The Story Miner
prompts.prompt: Interview me to find post ideas. Ask me 10 questions about my career, one at a time: mistakes, wins, lessons, unpopular opinions. After my answers, turn them into 20 post ideas with a hook for each, sorted by which would get the most **COMMENTS**.

prompts.name: The Post Builder
prompts.sub: From rough idea to finished post
prompts.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about [IDEA] for [AUDIENCE]. Structure: a hook line under 12 words, a short story or example, 3 practical takeaways, and a question that invites comments. Short lines, no hashtags in the text, no buzzwords like 'game-changer'.

prompts.name: The Comment Strategist
prompts.sub: Grow by commenting on the right posts
prompts.prompt: I want clients among [AUDIENCE]. List 10 kinds of creators and posts I should comment on every day, and write 5 comment templates that add a real insight instead of 'Great post!'. Add a 20-minute **DAILY ROUTINE** for it.

prompts.name: The DM Opener
prompts.prompt: Someone in [AUDIENCE] liked 3 of my posts about [TOPIC]. Write 3 friendly DM openers that start a conversation without pitching, a follow-up if they reply, and the moment it's okay to **MENTION MY OFFER**: [OFFER].

prompts.name: The Weekly Review
prompts.prompt: Here are my posts this week with impressions, comments and profile views: [PASTE STATS]. Tell me which topic and hook style worked, which to drop, and plan next week's 5 posts with hooks based on the **WINNERS**.

packs.title_tr: AI ile YouTube Shorts kanalı kurup büyütmek
packs.title: prompts to launch a YouTube Shorts channel with AI
packs.headline: Build a YouTube Shorts channel that pays you every month, with AI doing the heavy lifting. 7 prompts:

prompts.name: The Channel Concept
prompts.sub: An idea people binge, not scroll past
prompts.prompt: Act as a YouTube Shorts strategist. I can make videos about [TOPIC] with [TIME PER WEEK] hours a week and [EQUIPMENT]. Give me 5 channel concepts with a series format for each, the target viewer, why they'd **SUBSCRIBE**, and one sample video title.

prompts.name: The 60-Second Script
prompts.sub: Keep viewers to the last second
prompts.prompt: Write a YouTube Shorts script about [TOPIC], 45-60 seconds. Line 1 must make people stay. Then 3 fast beats with a visual for each, a **PATTERN INTERRUPT** in the middle, and an ending that loops back to the start. Mark the on-screen text separately.

prompts.name: The Series Planner
prompts.prompt: Plan a 30-video Shorts series for my channel about [TOPIC]. Group them into 3 themes, order them so each video makes people want the next, and give each a title under 50 characters and a **FIRST LINE** hook.

prompts.name: The Title Tester
prompts.prompt: Here is my Short: [DESCRIBE VIDEO]. Write 10 title options under 50 characters using curiosity, numbers, and outcomes. Rate each for clarity and curiosity from 1-10, and tell me which **2** to A/B test.

prompts.name: The Repurposer
prompts.prompt: Here is the transcript of my long video: [PASTE TRANSCRIPT]. Find the 10 best moments for Shorts. For each: the start and end sentence, a new hook to add at the start, and the on-screen text. Rank them by **VIRAL POTENTIAL**.

prompts.name: The Retention Fixer
prompts.prompt: My Short about [TOPIC] has [PERCENT]% average view duration. Here is the script: [PASTE SCRIPT]. Point out the exact lines where viewers probably swipe away, why, and rewrite those parts to keep them **WATCHING**.

prompts.name: The Money Plan
prompts.sub: What the channel can earn beyond ads
prompts.prompt: Act as a creator business coach. My Shorts channel about [TOPIC] has [SUBSCRIBERS] subscribers. List realistic income sources besides ad revenue (affiliates, sponsors, a product, services), what each needs, and a **90-DAY** plan to start the first one.

packs.title_tr: Yerel işletmelere AI asistan / agent satmak
packs.title: prompts to sell AI assistants to local businesses
packs.headline: Sell AI assistants to local businesses for $500 a month each. 7 prompts to land your first client:

prompts.name: The Pain Finder
prompts.sub: Where small businesses lose time and money
prompts.prompt: Act as an AI consultant for small businesses. For a [BUSINESS TYPE] in [CITY], list the 7 most repetitive tasks (bookings, FAQs, reviews, follow-ups) an AI assistant could handle, the hours each wastes per week, and which one is the **EASIEST TO SELL**.

prompts.name: The Offer Builder
prompts.sub: A package owners understand in 10 seconds
prompts.prompt: Turn this into a clear offer for [BUSINESS TYPE]: an AI assistant that [WHAT IT DOES]. Write the offer name, a one-line promise without hype, what's included, setup time, a monthly price of [$PRICE], and a **RISK-FREE** first-month option.

prompts.name: The Build Plan
prompts.sub: What you actually set up, step by step
prompts.prompt: Act as a no-code automation expert. Give me the step-by-step build for an AI assistant that [WHAT IT DOES] for a [BUSINESS TYPE], using [TOOLS]. Include the data it needs, where it runs, how the owner **HANDS OVER** to a human, and what can go wrong.

prompts.name: The Walk-In Pitch
prompts.sub: What to say in the first 30 seconds
prompts.prompt: Write a 30-second pitch I can say to the owner of a [BUSINESS TYPE] face to face, and a short follow-up email. Start with a problem they recognize, show one concrete example, and end with an offer to set up a **FREE DEMO** on their real questions.

prompts.name: The Objection Handler
prompts.prompt: List the 8 objections a [BUSINESS TYPE] owner will most likely raise about an AI assistant, and write a calm, honest answer to each, 2 sentences max. Include what to do when the objection is **ACTUALLY RIGHT**.

prompts.name: The Demo Script
prompts.prompt: Plan a 10-minute demo of an AI assistant for [BUSINESS NAME]. Use 5 real questions their customers ask (from their reviews or website: [PASTE]), show how the assistant answers, and end with the setup timeline and **ONE NEXT STEP**.

prompts.name: The First 10 Clients
prompts.prompt: Build my 30-day plan to sign 10 local clients for AI assistants in [CITY]: which business types to start with, how many to contact per day and where, a simple tracking sheet, and what to change if nobody says **YES** after two weeks.

packs.title_tr: Instagram yorum → DM otomasyonuyla satış (AI agent)
packs.title: prompts to turn comments into sales with DM automation
packs.headline: "Comment GUIDE": the Instagram trick that turns comments into sales on autopilot. 7 prompts to build it:

prompts.name: The Lead Magnet
prompts.prompt: Act as a funnel strategist. My audience is [AUDIENCE] and I sell [PRODUCT]. Give me 5 free lead magnet ideas people would comment a keyword to get (checklist, template, mini-guide), how fast I can make each, and which one leads most **NATURALLY** to my product.

prompts.name: The Keyword Post
prompts.sub: A post built to get comments
prompts.prompt: Write an Instagram carousel outline that ends with 'Comment [KEYWORD] and I'll send you [FREEBIE]'. 7 slides: a hook, 5 value slides that make people want more, and the ask. Add a caption whose first line repeats the **KEYWORD** offer.

prompts.name: The DM Flow
prompts.sub: The auto-reply that doesn't feel automatic
prompts.prompt: Write the automated DM sequence for people who comment [KEYWORD]: the first message with the freebie, a question to learn what they need, 2 reply branches based on their answer, and a soft offer for [PRODUCT]. Friendly, short, and **HUMAN**.

prompts.name: The Tool Setup
prompts.prompt: Explain step by step how to set up comment-to-DM automation for Instagram with [TOOL], using only official, policy-compliant features. Include the trigger, the message steps, how to tag leads, and the **LIMITS** or rules I must respect.

prompts.name: The Follow-Up Sequence
prompts.sub: For people who took the freebie and went quiet
prompts.prompt: Write a 3-message follow-up for people who got my free [FREEBIE] but didn't buy [PRODUCT]: day 2 (a useful tip), day 4 (a short customer story), day 7 (a clear offer with a deadline). Each under 60 words, **NO GUILT-TRIPPING**.

prompts.name: The Objection DMs
prompts.prompt: People reply to my DMs about [PRODUCT] with: 'how much?', 'I'll think about it', 'is it worth it?', 'I don't have time'. Write a short, honest reply to each that answers the real worry and gives **ONE** next step.

prompts.name: The Funnel Review
prompts.sub: Find the leak in your numbers
prompts.prompt: Here are my funnel numbers: [COMMENTS] comments, [DMS] DMs sent, [REPLIES] replies, [SALES] sales. Tell me where the biggest leak is, 3 likely reasons, and one test for each stage I can run **THIS WEEK**.

packs.title_tr: AI agent ile haftalık bülten (newsletter) kurup para kazanmak
packs.title: prompts to launch a newsletter an AI agent helps you write
packs.headline: A newsletter with 1,000 readers can pay you every single week. 7 AI prompts to build yours:

prompts.name: The Newsletter Idea
prompts.sub: A topic people open every week
prompts.prompt: Act as a newsletter strategist. I know about [TOPIC] and can write [HOURS] hours a week. Give me 5 newsletter concepts with a name, the reader, the promise in one line, the weekly format, and how each could make money at **1,000 READERS**.

prompts.name: The Research Agent
prompts.prompt: Design a weekly research workflow for my newsletter about [TOPIC] using [n8n / Make / Zapier] and an AI model: which sources it checks, how it summarizes and ranks the week's items, and the **SHORTLIST** it sends me every [DAY].

prompts.name: The Issue Writer
prompts.sub: From links to a finished issue
prompts.prompt: Here are this week's items for my newsletter about [TOPIC]: [PASTE LINKS AND NOTES]. Write the issue: a subject line, a 2-line intro in my voice, 5 short items with 'why it matters', one practical tip, and a closing question. **NO FILLER**.

prompts.name: The Subject Line Lab
prompts.prompt: Write 12 subject lines for this newsletter issue: [PASTE SUMMARY]. Mix curiosity, a number, a benefit, and a name. Keep them under 45 characters, avoid spam words, and pick the **TOP 2** to A/B test with the reason.

prompts.name: The Growth Plan
prompts.prompt: Build a 60-day plan to get my first 1,000 subscribers for a newsletter about [TOPIC]: where my readers hang out, 3 content ideas that point to the signup, a referral reward, and weekly targets I can **TRACK**.

prompts.name: The Sponsor Kit
prompts.prompt: Write a one-page sponsor kit for my newsletter about [TOPIC] with [SUBSCRIBERS] subscribers and [OPEN RATE]% opens: who reads it, ad formats, prices per issue, 3 example brands that fit, and a short **PITCH EMAIL**.

prompts.name: The Paid Tier
prompts.prompt: Act as a subscription product designer. My free newsletter covers [TOPIC]. Suggest 5 things readers would pay [$PRICE] a month for, estimate what share of readers might upgrade, and design a **LAUNCH EMAIL** for the best option.

packs.title_tr: Bir hafta sonunda dijital ürün yapıp satmak
packs.title: prompts to create and sell a digital product this weekend
packs.headline: Build a digital product on Saturday, get your first sale on Sunday. 7 prompts that do the heavy lifting:

prompts.name: The Product Finder
prompts.prompt: Act as a digital product strategist. I'm good at [SKILL] and know [AUDIENCE]. Give me 7 digital product ideas I can finish in one weekend (templates, checklists, guides, prompt packs), the problem each solves, a fair price, and which one has the **FASTEST FIRST SALE**.

prompts.name: The Outline Maker
prompts.sub: The full product plan in 5 minutes
prompts.prompt: Create the complete outline for [PRODUCT IDEA] for [AUDIENCE]: sections, what goes into each, examples to include, and the one 'quick win' the buyer gets in the **FIRST 10 MINUTES**. Keep it small enough to finish in 2 days.

prompts.name: The Content Drafter
prompts.sub: Write the product section by section
prompts.prompt: Write section [NUMBER] of my product [PRODUCT NAME] based on this outline: [PASTE OUTLINE]. Practical, specific, with one example and one mini exercise. Plain language for [AUDIENCE], no padding, and flag anything I should **CHECK** myself.

prompts.name: The Sales Page
prompts.sub: A page that explains and sells
prompts.prompt: Write a short sales page for [PRODUCT NAME] at [$PRICE]: a headline, the problem, what's inside as bullet points, who it's for and **NOT FOR**, 3 honest FAQs, and a clear buy button text. No fake testimonials, no fake scarcity.

prompts.name: The Launch Posts
prompts.prompt: Write 5 social media posts to launch [PRODUCT NAME] on [PLATFORM]: a behind-the-scenes post, a problem post, a sneak peek, a 'who it's for' post, and a launch-day post. Give each a hook and a caption with **ONE** call to action.

prompts.name: The Price Tester
prompts.prompt: Help me price [PRODUCT NAME] for [AUDIENCE]. Compare 3 price points ([$LOW], [$MID], [$HIGH]), what each signals, a bundle or upsell idea, and a simple way to test prices in the **FIRST 2 WEEKS**.

prompts.name: The Feedback Loop
prompts.prompt: Write a short thank-you email for buyers of [PRODUCT NAME] with 3 questions that tell me what to improve, and plan version 2: what to add based on likely answers, and how to turn happy buyers into **REVIEWS** without pressure.

packs.title_tr: Becerine ve haftada 5 saate uyan yan gelir bulmak
packs.title: prompts to find a side hustle that fits 5 hours a week
packs.headline: Turn 5 free hours a week into an extra $1,000 a month. 7 prompts to find your side hustle:

prompts.name: The Skill Scanner
prompts.sub: What you know that others pay for
prompts.prompt: Interview me to find my sellable skills. Ask me 8 questions, one at a time, about my job, hobbies, what friends ask me for help with, and tools I use. Then list 5 skills people pay for, with **PROOF** that a market exists for each.

prompts.name: The Hustle Matcher
prompts.sub: Ideas that fit your real life
prompts.prompt: Act as a career coach. My skills: [SKILLS]. I have [HOURS] hours a week, [$BUDGET] to start, and I prefer [ONLINE/OFFLINE]. Suggest 7 side hustles that fit, with startup cost, time to first income, a realistic monthly range, and the **BIGGEST RISK** of each.

prompts.name: The Reality Check
prompts.sub: Kill bad ideas before they cost you
prompts.prompt: Be brutally honest about this side hustle idea: [IDEA]. What does a typical beginner earn in the first 3 months, what does it really cost in time, what do most people get wrong, and what would make you say **DON'T DO IT**?

prompts.name: The 7-Day Test
prompts.sub: Prove it with one small sale
prompts.prompt: Design a 7-day experiment to test [SIDE HUSTLE] with under [$BUDGET]: day-by-day tasks under 45 minutes, the smallest offer I can sell, where to find the first 3 customers, and the number that tells me to **CONTINUE OR STOP**.

prompts.name: The Offer Writer
prompts.sub: Say what you sell in one sentence
prompts.prompt: Write my offer for [SIDE HUSTLE] for [AUDIENCE]: a one-sentence description, 3 package options with prices, what's included, the delivery time, and a short message I can send to 10 people I know **TODAY**.

prompts.name: The Time Planner
prompts.sub: Fit it around a full-time job
prompts.prompt: I work [WORK HOURS] and have these free slots: [FREE TIME]. Build a weekly schedule for my side hustle [SIDE HUSTLE] that avoids burnout: which tasks go in which slot, what to automate or batch, and **ONE DAY OFF** that stays off.

prompts.name: The Scale Plan
prompts.sub: From first sale to steady income
prompts.prompt: My side hustle [SIDE HUSTLE] made [$AMOUNT] last month from [CLIENTS] clients. What should I change to reach [$GOAL] a month without doubling my hours? Cover pricing, packaging, repeat clients, and what to **STOP DOING**.

packs.title_tr: Maaş zammı / iş teklifi pazarlığı
packs.title: prompts to negotiate a higher salary
packs.headline: Use these 7 AI prompts before your next salary talk and ask for 20% more with confidence:

prompts.name: The Market Check
prompts.sub: Know your number before the meeting
prompts.prompt: Act as a compensation advisor. I'm a [JOB TITLE] with [YEARS] years of experience in [CITY/COUNTRY] at a [COMPANY SIZE] company. Tell me which salary data sources to check, what to compare, and how to set a **TARGET, ANCHOR AND WALK-AWAY** number.

prompts.name: The Value Ledger
prompts.prompt: Help me build my case for a raise. Here's what I did this year: [PASTE NOTES]. Turn it into 5 achievements with numbers (money saved, time saved, revenue, growth), ordered by impact, each in **ONE SENTENCE** my manager can repeat to their boss.

prompts.name: The Opening Script
prompts.sub: The first 60 seconds of the talk
prompts.prompt: Write what I say in the first minute of my raise conversation with [MANAGER ROLE]. Calm, confident, not apologetic. Mention my top 2 results, the number [$TARGET], and end with a question that opens a **REAL CONVERSATION**.

prompts.name: The Pushback Drill
prompts.prompt: Role-play my manager during a salary negotiation. Push back realistically: 'no budget', 'not this year', 'others earn the same', 'we'll review later'. After each of my answers, score it 1-10 and show me a **STRONGER** version.

prompts.name: The Offer Decoder
prompts.sub: Compare job offers beyond the salary
prompts.prompt: Compare these job offers: [PASTE OFFERS]. Include salary, bonus, equity, benefits, remote days, growth and commute. Turn them into a yearly value in [CURRENCY], point out hidden costs, and tell me which terms are **NEGOTIABLE**.

prompts.name: The Counter Email
prompts.sub: Ask for more in writing, politely
prompts.prompt: Write a short counteroffer email for the [JOB TITLE] offer at [COMPANY]. I'm excited about the role, the offer is [$OFFER], I'm asking for [$COUNTER] based on [REASONS]. Warm, specific, and with one **ALTERNATIVE** if salary is fixed.

prompts.name: The Plan B
prompts.prompt: My raise request was declined. Write a reply that keeps the relationship strong, and ask for a written plan: which goals, by when, and what raise follows. Then list non-salary things to ask for **NOW** (title, training, remote days, bonus).

packs.title_tr: Freelancer olarak daha yüksek fiyat almak ve teklif yazmak
packs.title: prompts to charge more as a freelancer
packs.headline: Freelancers: double your rates without losing clients. 7 prompts for pricing, proposals and raises:

prompts.name: The Rate Calculator
prompts.prompt: Act as a freelance business coach. I want to earn [$YEARLY GOAL] a year, can bill about [HOURS] hours a week, and pay [TAX]% tax and [$COSTS] in costs. Calculate my **MINIMUM** hourly and day rate, then a project price for [TYPICAL PROJECT].

prompts.name: The Value Pricer
prompts.sub: Price the result, not the hours
prompts.prompt: My client wants [PROJECT]. It will help them [BUSINESS RESULT]. Help me price by value: estimate what the result is worth to them, suggest 3 package options (basic, standard, premium), and write how to explain the price **WITHOUT HOURS**.

prompts.name: The Proposal Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a one-page proposal for [CLIENT] for [PROJECT]: their goal in their words, my approach in 3 steps, timeline, 3 package options with prices, what's not included, and the **NEXT STEP**. Confident, short, no jargon.

prompts.name: The Scope Guard
prompts.prompt: My client keeps adding requests to [PROJECT]. Write a friendly message that confirms what's in scope, prices the extra work at [$RATE], and offers two options. Also give me a scope clause for **FUTURE CONTRACTS**.

prompts.name: The Raise Announcement
prompts.sub: Tell current clients about new rates
prompts.prompt: Write an email to my existing clients announcing that my rate goes from [$OLD] to [$NEW] on [DATE]. Thank them, explain the value briefly, offer a grace period for booked work, and keep the tone **CONFIDENT**, not apologetic.

prompts.name: The Niche Upgrade
prompts.prompt: I'm a generalist [SERVICE] freelancer. Suggest 5 niches where [SERVICE] is worth more, why clients there pay more, what I would need to learn, and how to reposition my profile in **ONE WEEK**.

prompts.name: The Retainer Pitch
prompts.prompt: Write a pitch that turns my one-off client [CLIENT] into a monthly retainer for [SERVICE]: what I would do every month, the result it protects, 2 retainer levels with prices, and a **TRIAL MONTH** offer.

packs.title_tr: AI becerilerini hizmete çevirip satmak
packs.title: prompts to turn your AI skills into paid services
packs.headline: You already use ChatGPT every day. Turn it into $2,000 a month with these 7 prompts:

prompts.name: The Service Menu
prompts.prompt: Act as an AI services consultant. I can use [AI TOOLS] well. List 10 services I can sell to [AUDIENCE] (content repurposing, chatbots, data cleanup, prompt libraries ...), who buys each, typical prices, and which one needs the **LEAST EXPERIENCE**.

prompts.name: The Before/After Demo
prompts.sub: Show the value in one screenshot
prompts.prompt: Plan a before/after demo for my service [SERVICE] for [AUDIENCE]: the messy 'before' example, the exact AI steps I use, the 'after' result, and how long it took. Write it as a short post that makes people **DM ME**.

prompts.name: The Workflow Recorder
prompts.prompt: I deliver [SERVICE] for clients. Turn my process into a repeatable workflow: the inputs I need from the client, the prompts for each step, quality checks, and the final format. Point out which step I could **AUTOMATE** next.

prompts.name: The Quality Checker
prompts.sub: Catch AI mistakes before the client does
prompts.prompt: Act as a strict editor. Review this AI-assisted work for my client: [PASTE WORK]. Check facts that need a source, generic phrases, tone mismatches with [BRAND VOICE], and anything that looks **AI-WRITTEN**. List fixes by priority.

prompts.name: The Client Brief
prompts.sub: Ask the right questions up front
prompts.prompt: Write a short onboarding questionnaire for clients of my [SERVICE]: 10 questions about goals, audience, examples they like, what to avoid, and access I need. Add one question that reveals their **REAL SUCCESS METRIC**.

prompts.name: The Upwork Profile
prompts.prompt: Write my freelance profile for [PLATFORM] as an AI [SERVICE] specialist: a title under 70 characters, an overview that starts with the client's problem, 3 portfolio item descriptions, and the **KEYWORDS** clients search for.

prompts.name: The Package Ladder
prompts.prompt: Design a pricing ladder for my AI service [SERVICE]: a small [$LOW] test project, a main package, and a monthly plan. For each: what's included, delivery time, and the moment I **OFFER THE NEXT STEP** up.

packs.title_tr: Yatırıma başlamadan önce temelleri öğrenmek
packs.title: prompts to understand investing before your first $100
packs.headline: Invest your first $100 the smart way. 7 prompts that teach you what most beginners never learn:

prompts.name: The Plain-English Tutor
prompts.prompt: Explain these investing terms like I'm a smart 15-year-old, with one everyday example each: index fund, ETF, stock, bond, dividend, expense ratio, diversification, compound interest. Then quiz me with **5 QUESTIONS**.

prompts.name: The Goal Sorter
prompts.prompt: Help me sort my goals before investing: [LIST GOALS WITH AMOUNTS AND DATES]. For each, tell me if it's short, medium or long term, why that matters for risk, and which goals should stay in **SAVINGS** instead of investments.

prompts.name: The Risk Profiler
prompts.sub: How much drop can you handle
prompts.prompt: Ask me 8 questions, one at a time, to understand my risk tolerance: income stability, emergency fund, timeline, how I'd react to a 30% drop. Then describe my profile and what it usually means for a portfolio, **WITHOUT** recommending specific products.

prompts.name: The Compound Visualizer
prompts.sub: See what time does to money
prompts.prompt: Show me a table of what [$MONTHLY AMOUNT] a month becomes after 5, 10, 20 and 30 years at 4%, 6% and 8% yearly returns. Then show the same if I start 5 years later, and explain the difference in **TWO SENTENCES**.

prompts.name: The Fee Detective
prompts.prompt: Compare the long-term cost of a 0.1%, 0.5% and 1.5% yearly fee on [$AMOUNT] invested for [YEARS] years with a 6% return. Show the money lost to fees in a table and list **5 QUESTIONS** to ask about fees before I open any account.

prompts.name: The Myth Buster
prompts.prompt: List the 10 most common beginner investing mistakes (timing the market, chasing hype, no emergency fund ...). For each: why people do it, what it can cost, and one **SIMPLE RULE** that prevents it.

prompts.name: The Advisor Prep
prompts.prompt: I'm meeting a financial advisor about investing [$AMOUNT] for [GOAL]. Write 12 questions to ask about fees, conflicts of interest, risk, and how they get paid, plus the **RED FLAGS** in their answers that should make me walk away.

packs.title_tr: AI ile trading günlüğü, risk yönetimi ve disiplin
packs.title: prompts to turn AI into your trading coach
packs.headline: Most traders lose because they never review their trades. 7 prompts that turn AI into your trading coach:

prompts.name: The Trade Plan
prompts.prompt: Act as a trading coach. Help me write my trading plan for [MARKET] on the [TIMEFRAME] chart: which setups I take, entry and exit rules, max risk per trade, max trades per day, and the conditions where I **DON'T TRADE** at all.

prompts.name: The Position Sizer
prompts.sub: Never risk more than you planned
prompts.prompt: My account is [$ACCOUNT], I risk [RISK]% per trade. Entry [PRICE], stop loss [STOP], target [TARGET]. Calculate position size, the money at risk, the reward-to-risk ratio, and tell me if this trade **FITS MY RULES**: [RULES].

prompts.name: The Journal Analyst
prompts.sub: Find the pattern in your losses
prompts.prompt: Here is my trade journal from the last month: [PASTE TRADES WITH DATE, SETUP, ENTRY, EXIT, RESULT, NOTES]. Find my win rate per setup, time of day, and emotion tag, and name the **ONE HABIT** that costs me the most.

prompts.name: The Post-Mortem
prompts.prompt: Review this losing trade like a strict coach: [DESCRIBE TRADE AND WHAT I WAS THINKING]. Was it a bad trade or a good trade that lost? Which rule did I break, what did I ignore, and what is the **LESSON** in one sentence?

prompts.name: The Tilt Check
prompts.prompt: Before each session, ask me 6 short questions about sleep, mood, recent losses and why I want to trade today. Based on my answers, tell me to trade normally, reduce size, or **SKIP THE DAY**, and explain why.

prompts.name: The Backtest Designer
prompts.sub: Test the idea before real money
prompts.prompt: I have a trading idea: [DESCRIBE STRATEGY]. Turn it into exact, testable rules, design a manual backtest on [NUMBER] past examples, the numbers to record for each, and the results that would make me **DROP THE IDEA**.

prompts.name: The Weekly Review
prompts.prompt: Here's my week: [TRADES, P/L, RULE BREAKS, NOTES]. Write my weekly review: what went well, what went wrong, whether I followed my plan (score 1-10), and **ONE FOCUS** for next week with a way to measure it.

packs.title_tr: Piyasa haberlerini, bilançoları ve Fed kararlarını AI ile çözmek
packs.title: prompts to decode market news with AI
packs.headline: Understand every market move before everyone else. 7 prompts that make AI decode the financial news:

prompts.name: The Earnings Explainer
prompts.prompt: Here is an earnings report or summary for [COMPANY]: [PASTE TEXT]. Explain in plain English: revenue and profit vs last year, what management expects next, the **3 NUMBERS** investors will focus on, and what was left unsaid.

prompts.name: The Rate Decision Decoder
prompts.sub: What a central bank decision means for you
prompts.prompt: Explain this central bank statement for a normal person: [PASTE STATEMENT]. What changed, why they did it, how it could affect loans, savings, stocks and [CURRENCY], and which **WORDS** markets will read between the lines.

prompts.name: The Move Explainer
prompts.prompt: [ASSET] moved [PERCENT]% today. Based on this news: [PASTE NEWS], list the possible reasons, which one is most likely, what is confirmed vs **SPECULATION**, and what information would change the picture.

prompts.name: The Scenario Planner
prompts.prompt: I'm watching [ASSET] ahead of [EVENT]. Build 3 scenarios (better than expected, as expected, worse), what each could mean for the price, the signals that confirm each, and how my plan changes, **WITHOUT** predicting the outcome.

prompts.name: The Jargon Translator
prompts.prompt: Translate this analyst or news text into plain English, sentence by sentence: [PASTE TEXT]. Mark every piece of jargon, explain it in one line, and tell me which statements are facts and which are **OPINIONS**.

prompts.name: The Watchlist Builder
prompts.sub: Follow the calendar, not the hype
prompts.prompt: Build my watchlist routine for [MARKET]: which economic events and earnings dates to follow this month, what each one usually moves, where to find the official data, and a **15-MINUTE** morning checklist.

prompts.name: The Bias Check
prompts.sub: Are you reading news to confirm what you want
prompts.prompt: I think [ASSET] will go [UP/DOWN] because [REASONS]. Argue the strongest opposite case, list the evidence that would prove me wrong, and name the cognitive **BIASES** that might be shaping my view.

packs.title_tr: Doktor randevusuna hazırlanmak, tahlil terimlerini anlamak
packs.title: prompts to get more out of every doctor visit
packs.headline: You only get 15 minutes with your doctor. These 7 AI prompts make every minute count:

prompts.name: The Symptom Timeline
prompts.prompt: Help me prepare for a doctor visit. Ask me questions one at a time about my symptoms: when they started, how often, what makes them better or worse, what I've tried. Then write a clear **ONE-PAGE TIMELINE** I can hand to my doctor. Don't diagnose.

prompts.name: The Question List
prompts.prompt: I have an appointment about [CONDITION OR SYMPTOM]. Write the 10 most useful questions to ask my doctor, ordered by importance, including questions about tests, treatment options, side effects, and **WHEN TO COME BACK**.

prompts.name: The Lab Report Explainer
prompts.prompt: Explain what each item on my lab report measures, in plain language: [PASTE ITEM NAMES AND UNITS]. Don't interpret my results or diagnose. Instead, tell me **WHICH QUESTIONS** to ask my doctor about the values marked high or low.

prompts.name: The Medication Organizer
prompts.sub: Never forget a dose or a question
prompts.prompt: Here are my current medications and supplements as listed on the labels: [LIST]. Build a daily schedule table exactly as the labels say, and a list of **QUESTIONS FOR MY PHARMACIST** about timing and combinations. Don't change any doses.

prompts.name: The Visit Summary
prompts.prompt: Here are my rough notes from today's doctor visit: [PASTE NOTES]. Turn them into a clean summary: what the doctor said, next steps with dates, medications, warning signs they mentioned, and anything I should **CLARIFY** by phone.

prompts.name: The Health Log
prompts.prompt: Design a simple daily log to track [SYMPTOM OR CONDITION] for 4 weeks: what to record (time, intensity 1-10, triggers, sleep, food), in a table I can fill in 2 minutes a day, and how to **SUMMARIZE** it for my next visit.

prompts.name: The Second Opinion Prep
prompts.sub: Ask better questions about a diagnosis
prompts.prompt: My doctor said I have [DIAGNOSIS] and suggested [TREATMENT]. Explain in plain language what that condition is, the common treatment options doctors discuss, and write 8 questions for a **SECOND OPINION**. Don't recommend a treatment.

packs.title_tr: Uyku, enerji, beslenme ve egzersiz rutini (yoğun insanlar için)
packs.title: prompts to build an energy routine for busy days
packs.headline: No more 3 PM crash: 7 AI prompts that build a sleep, food and workout routine for busy people:

prompts.name: The Energy Audit
prompts.prompt: Ask me 10 questions, one at a time, about my sleep, caffeine, meals, screen time, movement and stress on a typical day. Then show me the **3 BIGGEST** energy drains in my routine and one small fix for each.

prompts.name: The Sleep Protocol
prompts.prompt: I go to bed around [TIME], wake at [TIME], and usually [SLEEP PROBLEM]. Build a realistic 60-minute wind-down routine and a morning routine based on common sleep hygiene advice, with **ONE CHANGE** per week for 4 weeks.

prompts.name: The Meal Planner
prompts.sub: A week of food in 5 minutes
prompts.prompt: Plan 7 days of simple meals for [DIET PREFERENCE] with [MINUTES] minutes to cook per day and a budget of [$BUDGET]. Include a shopping list grouped by aisle, 2 batch-cooking sessions, and snacks that don't cause an **AFTERNOON CRASH**.

prompts.name: The Desk Workout
prompts.prompt: Design a 20-minute workout I can do at home with no equipment, 4 times a week, for a [FITNESS LEVEL] beginner. Show each exercise, sets and reps, an easier version, and how to **PROGRESS** over 6 weeks.

prompts.name: The Habit Stacker
prompts.sub: New habits glued to old ones
prompts.prompt: I want to build these habits: [HABITS]. My fixed daily routine is: [ROUTINE]. Attach each new habit to an existing one (habit stacking), start each at a **2-MINUTE** version, and give me a simple checklist to track them.

prompts.name: The Focus Blocks
prompts.sub: Work with your energy, not against it
prompts.prompt: My energy is highest at [TIME] and lowest at [TIME]. My daily tasks are: [TASKS]. Plan a workday that puts deep work, meetings, breaks and a short walk in the right slots, and **PROTECTS** my best hours.

prompts.name: The Weekly Check-In
prompts.prompt: Here is my week: sleep hours, workouts done, meals, energy 1-10 per day: [PASTE]. Tell me what's working, what to adjust, and set next week's **ONE GOAL**. Be encouraging but honest.

packs.title_tr: Herhangi bir beceriyi 30 günde öğrenmek
packs.title: prompts to learn any skill in 30 days
packs.headline: Learn any skill in 30 days with ChatGPT as your personal teacher. 7 prompts:

prompts.name: The Skill Map
prompts.prompt: I want to learn [SKILL] in 30 days, [MINUTES] minutes a day, starting from [LEVEL]. Break the skill into sub-skills, mark the **20% THAT MATTERS MOST** for beginners, and turn it into a day-by-day plan with a small project every week.

prompts.name: The Project Coach
prompts.prompt: Suggest 4 small projects for learning [SKILL], each harder than the last, that I can finish in a week. For each: what I'll build, the skills it trains, the resources I need, and how I'll know it's **DONE**.

prompts.name: The Explain-Back Test
prompts.sub: If you can't explain it, you don't know it
prompts.prompt: I just learned about [CONCEPT]. I'll explain it in my own words: [MY EXPLANATION]. Grade my explanation, point out gaps and misunderstandings, then ask me **3 QUESTIONS** that test if I really got it.

prompts.name: The Quiz Master
prompts.prompt: Create 15 quiz questions on [TOPIC] for my level: [LEVEL]. Mix recall, application and tricky cases. Ask them one at a time, wait for my answer, correct me, and at the end list the ones I should **REVIEW IN 3 DAYS**.

prompts.name: The Mistake Finder
prompts.sub: Get feedback like from a mentor
prompts.prompt: Here is my practice work for [SKILL]: [PASTE WORK OR DESCRIBE IT]. Review it like a demanding mentor: the 3 most important mistakes, why they matter, how to fix each, and **ONE EXERCISE** to practice the weakest point.

prompts.name: The Book Compressor
prompts.prompt: Summarize the main ideas of [BOOK OR COURSE] for someone learning [SKILL]: the 7 key ideas, one example each, what to try in practice this week, and what the author is often **CRITICIZED** for. Tell me if you're unsure about any detail.

prompts.name: The Stuck Breaker
prompts.prompt: I'm on day [DAY] of learning [SKILL] and I'm stuck: [DESCRIBE PROBLEM]. Figure out whether it's a plateau, a missing basic, or motivation, and give me a **SMALLER NEXT STEP** I can do in 15 minutes today.

packs.title_tr: Spiritüel protokoller: sabah niyeti, akşam muhasebesi, günlük
packs.title: reflection protocols to calm your mind with AI
packs.headline: The morning and evening protocol that calms your mind in 10 minutes a day. 7 AI prompts:

prompts.name: The Morning Intention
prompts.prompt: Guide me through a 5-minute morning intention practice. Ask me 3 questions one at a time: how I feel, what matters most today, and who I want to be in my hardest moment. Then write my **INTENTION** for today in one sentence.

prompts.name: The Evening Review
prompts.prompt: Lead me through an evening review inspired by the Stoic practice. Ask me, one at a time: what went well, where I fell short of my values, what I can learn, and what I'm **GRATEFUL** for. Reflect my answers back kindly and briefly.

prompts.name: The Values Compass
prompts.prompt: Help me find my core values. Ask me 7 questions about proud moments, people I admire, and times I felt angry or empty. Then name my **5 CORE VALUES** in my own words, with one daily action that honors each.

prompts.name: The Guided Meditation
prompts.sub: A script made for your day
prompts.prompt: Write a [MINUTES]-minute guided meditation script for [SITUATION, E.G. BEFORE A HARD CONVERSATION]. Calm pace, breathing cues, simple imagery, short sentences, and **PAUSES** marked in brackets so I can record it and play it back.

prompts.name: The Worry Sorter
prompts.prompt: Here's what is on my mind: [LIST WORRIES]. Sort each into 'I can act on it', 'I can influence it', or 'I have to let it go'. For the first group, give **ONE SMALL ACTION** each; for the last, a short phrase to release it.

prompts.name: The Gratitude Deepener
prompts.prompt: Ask me to name one good thing from today. Then ask 3 follow-up questions that help me feel it more deeply: who made it possible, what it says about my life, and how I could **PASS IT ON** tomorrow.

prompts.name: The Digital Sabbath
prompts.prompt: Design a weekly digital-free half day for someone who works online: when to start, how to prepare, what to do instead (walks, reading, people, silence), how to handle urgent messages, and a short **REFLECTION** to end it.

packs.title_tr: Kârlı niş fikri bulmak ve 48 saatte test etmek
packs.title: prompts to find and test a profitable niche
packs.headline: Find a niche that pays and test it in 48 hours. 7 prompts before you waste 6 months:

prompts.name: The Niche Generator
prompts.prompt: Act as a niche research expert. My interests: [INTERESTS]. My skills: [SKILLS]. People I know well: [AUDIENCES]. Combine them into 10 specific niches (a person + a problem), and rate each on pain, ability to pay, and how **REACHABLE** they are for me.

prompts.name: The Demand Detective
prompts.prompt: For the niche [NICHE], tell me where to look for proof of demand: which forums, search terms, marketplaces and review sites, what signals to look for (complaints, paid products, 'how do I' questions), and what would count as **NO DEMAND**.

prompts.name: The Competitor X-Ray
prompts.prompt: Here are 3-5 competitors in [NICHE]: [NAMES, LINKS OR DESCRIPTIONS]. Compare their offer, price, audience and weak spots based on their reviews: [PASTE REVIEWS]. Find the **GAP** I could own, in one sentence.

prompts.name: The Offer Sketch
prompts.sub: Something small you could sell now
prompts.prompt: Design the smallest offer I could sell in [NICHE] within a week: format, price, what's included, delivery, and a one-sentence promise. Then a **BIGGER** version I could build later if the first one sells.

prompts.name: The 48-Hour Test
prompts.prompt: Plan a 48-hour test for [OFFER] in [NICHE]: the landing page text (headline, 3 bullets, button), where to get the first 100 visitors for free, what to measure, and the result that means **GO**, **TWEAK** or **KILL**.

prompts.name: The Name & Angle
prompts.prompt: Suggest 10 names and 5 positioning angles for my offer in [NICHE] for [AUDIENCE]. Avoid generic names, check that the angle is different from [COMPETITORS], and pick the **BEST COMBINATION** with the reason.

prompts.name: The Kill-or-Continue
prompts.prompt: Here are my test results for [OFFER]: [VISITORS] visitors, [SIGNUPS] signups, [SALES] sales, plus these comments: [PASTE]. Should I continue, change the offer, change the audience, or stop? Explain the decision like an **HONEST INVESTOR**.

packs.title_tr: Tek içeriği AI agent ile 10 platforma çoğaltmak
packs.title: prompts to turn one post into 10 with an AI agent
packs.headline: Post once, show up everywhere: an AI agent that turns one post into 10. 7 prompts to build it:

prompts.name: The Core Extractor
prompts.prompt: Here is my content: [PASTE ARTICLE, TRANSCRIPT OR POST]. Pull out the 5 strongest ideas, the best quote, one surprising fact, and one story. Rank them by how well they'd work as **STANDALONE POSTS**.

prompts.name: The Platform Translator
prompts.sub: Same idea, native on every platform
prompts.prompt: Turn this idea into native posts for 5 platforms: [IDEA]. A LinkedIn post, an X thread of 5 posts, an Instagram carousel outline, a 45-second Short script, and a newsletter paragraph. Match each platform's **TONE AND LENGTH**.

prompts.name: The Agent Workflow
prompts.prompt: Act as an automation architect. Design an AI agent in [n8n / Make / Zapier] that watches my [SOURCE, E.G. YOUTUBE CHANNEL], gets the transcript, drafts posts for [PLATFORMS], saves them in [TOOL] and asks me to **APPROVE** before anything goes live.

prompts.name: The Brand Voice Guard
prompts.prompt: Here are 5 examples of my best posts: [PASTE]. Write a brand voice guide the AI agent must follow: tone, words to use and avoid, emoji rules, sentence length, and a **CHECKLIST** to run on every draft before I see it.

prompts.name: The Carousel Builder
prompts.prompt: Turn this content into an 8-slide carousel: [PASTE]. Slide 1 a hook under 10 words, slides 2-7 one idea each with a short headline and 1-2 lines, slide 8 a clear call to action. Add a caption whose first line **STOPS THE SCROLL**.

prompts.name: The Posting Calendar
prompts.sub: Spread it out, don't dump it
prompts.prompt: I have [NUMBER] repurposed posts from one piece of content. Build a 2-week posting calendar across [PLATFORMS]: which post goes where and when, the best time slots to test, and how to **LINK THEM** back to the original.

prompts.name: The Performance Loop
prompts.sub: Let the data pick the next topic
prompts.prompt: Here are the results of my repurposed posts: [PASTE STATS PER PLATFORM]. Which platform and format worked best, which idea resonated everywhere, and what should my **NEXT PIECE** of long content be about?
